entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Yeah, yeah, just get me someone now! This is ridiculous.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and I'm with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Finally! I bought this Aero Race Jersey and it's a complete joke. It's the wrong size and I want to return it. Now.

I can certainly look into that for you. I understand you're upset about the jersey. To make sure I resolve this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the fit?

A preference?! Are you kidding me? It's way too tight! I can't even breathe in this thing. Your sizing chart is a lie! I wanted to do an exchange, but at this point, I just want my money back. This is unacceptable service. Get me your manager!

I understand your frustration, and I sincerely apologize for the issue with the fit. There's no need for a manager, I'm confident I can handle this for you. Let me just pull up your account... Okay, I see your order. I also see you're a VIP member with us, and we definitely want to make this right for you.
You're damn right you do. I spend a lot of money here. This is the last time if you don't fix this. I'll make sure everyone I know hears about it.

I appreciate your loyalty, and I assure you we'll get this sorted. I'm just checking our return policy for you... Okay, it looks like you received the item 14 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can process a full refund for you immediately.
Fine. That should have been the first thing you said. So what happens now? You just sending me a label?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return. I am emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. And for the trouble this has caused, I've also added a 20% discount coupon to your account for your next purchase.
Whatever. Just make sure that email comes through. The whole point was to get the right size jersey, not a headache.
The email has been sent. Again, my apologies for the inconvenience. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
